# PartnerLockup

gradnext set beside a partner brand with equal respect — neither logo dominates.

`Gradnext.PartnerLockup` · Brand

## Use

```jsx
<Gradnext.PartnerLockup />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Gradnext.PartnerLockup"></x-import>
```

## Notes

gradnext beside a partner brand at equal weight.

## Props (PartnerLockupProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `layout` | `"divider" \| "cross" \| "stacked"` | divider = vertical rule, cross = "×", stacked = horizontal rule. Default "divider". |
| `partner` | `React.ReactNode` | The partner's logo element (an <img>) or name. Default placeholder "Partner Brand". |
| `tone` | `"rhino" \| "white" \| "midnight" \| "ink"` | Wordmark ink. Default "midnight". |
| `height` | `number` | Wordmark height in px; match the partner logo's optical size. Default 32. |
